venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 10/12 (MOD MKZ).** Net sales $1,417 vs target $698 (+103%). Food $235. 36 guests, $39.37 check avg. Comps $42.40 (employee discounts, community/investor, industry, O4W). Sunny Monday, quiet 6-9pm; opener cut at 7. Large pop ~10pm when a film wrap-party group came in and stayed past close. Raven (day 4 of bartender training) supported Patty well. Needs: fruit fly enzyme order; glassware en route. 86: McCallan.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 10/12 (MOD KE, Chef DJ).** Net sales $983 vs target $1,000 (-1.7%). Food $211. 33 guests, ~$30 check avg. Comps $10.75 (1%). 'Pretty okay Monday' — small happy-hour office parties early, mix of first-time/return guests and a couple of dates later; improvement on last Monday. Lots of cleaning projects done. 86: Guinness draft, Taco Tuesday.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 10/12 (AM MOD Carey, PM MOD Maggie H).** Net sales $4,853.24 (DC/AM $702.57, D&C PM $4,150.67); no events; target not entered in the form ('Loading...'). Food $1,281.10. 111 guests (Tock), comps $249.31. 'Deader than the chicken that crossed the road' — opener cut very early, mid done before close, host gone before 10:30p. Evergreen syrup back, silverware near par. Low: smoked bourbon, green tea. Kitchen low: fingerlings, preserved lemon aioli, 8oz burgers, wagyu flanks. Tuesday: Baron App Inc. meeting, 31 guests 9am-5pm in Vauxhall.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 10/12 (Kyler, Thomas, Will).** Net sales $4,624 vs target $3,899 (+18.6%). Food $513, beverage $4,111. 128 covers, $36 check avg, comps $97. 9 solos, 3 large parties. Capacity ~8pm, lively until 10:30/11, tiny waitlist; many UK visitors and holiday-weekend groups. Top sellers: Burner Phone, Dirty Martinis, fries. Oysters sold out early. Breakage: customer coupe, sidecar. No no-shows.

venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 10/12.** No report submitted as of 10/13 8:00 UTC run; will retry next pass.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 10/12 (MOD Marcus), private event (Samsung host/POC).** EON posted 10/12 11:49pm with date mistyped as 10/11. Net sales / event sales entered as 'TBD' — dollar figures not yet reported; will recheck next pass. 212 guests (more than expected/prepped); hit capacity before 7pm, one-in-one-out; event extended from 9 to 10pm, last call held at 10pm. Target $1,937. Comps $0. Maintenance: curtains. Learnings: more comprehensive par sheet for events, limit classics selection, set last-call/extension terms, cap guest list.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 10/12 (AM Franck & Marcus; PM Justin & Shannon).** Net sales $5,207 vs target $3,994 (+30.4%). Municipal Bar AM $831, PM $4,020, Sun Club $356, Hot Eye $0. Food $2,210. 125 guests (15 AM + 110 PM OpenTable), comps $93.85. Four drinking tours boosted brunch into happy hour. Evening: one reservation on the books, walk-in driven; slower food, steady drinks; bar full last two hours, empty by 11. Low on toffee cakes.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 10/12 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net sales $5,900 vs target $7,000 (-15.7%). Food $939. 122 guests, $48.41 check avg. Comps ~$400 (~$100 shifts, ~$150 discounts, ~$150 SND/DNL). EON date mistyped as 10/26. Monday felt slower; team used time for punch-list items; Taylor in training. Kitchen out of sorts at points; need storage SOPs; only one cheese on the board. Prep-area breaker kept tripping (temp fix with power strip). 86: Grey Goose, cheese, prawns.
